text:
Tara Singh: Heads-up: staging mkdocs linkcheck flagged several 404 fragment failures that only appear in CI, not in my local build. failing examples show `#/guides/international#installing-with-locale` -> CI generated `#/guides/international#installing-with-loca01le` (note the decomposed accent).
Ben Walker: that looks like an NFC vs NFD Unicode normalization mismatch. macOS editors sometimes save composed (é) and some pipelines normalize differently during build. where are the source headings?
Tara Singh: in `docs/guides/international.md` the heading text uses an accented character in the H2: "Installing with locale" where the e has an accent copied from a contributor doc. can't see it in the editor.
Ivy Zhao: we saw this once before with accented examples in code snippets. CI's slugify util canonicalizes by NFC, but the preprocessor used by our importer left the raw bytes. result: generated anchor contains U+0301 combining acute instead of single U+00E9. browsers treat them as different fragments.
Luna Park: short-term: add redirects for the affected fragments in `redirects.yaml` so old links resolve. medium-term: sanitize files by normalizing to NFC on commit or during docs build.
Ben Walker: i can push a tiny pre-commit hook that runs `python -c "import unicodedata,sys; sys.stdout.write(unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", sys.stdin.read()))"` on `docs/**/*.md` changed files. would catch these before they reach CI.
Ivy Zhao: also adding a docs-lint rule that fails if any heading contains combining marks (regex: `\p{M}`) so authors get a clear error. PR #4512 coming up.
docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck failed for branch fix/unicode-normalize  3 broken fragments in docs/guides/international.md: lines 34-56
Tara Singh: i'll run a quick repo-wide check for combining marks: `git grep -nP "\p{M}" docs/ || true` and patch the handful of files.
Luna Park: please confirm that the slugify util used by both importer and site is the same version. mismatched versions also caused a similar issue earlier.
Ben Walker: confirmed: both call `docs/utils/slugify.py` but the importer vendor had a copy. i'll remove the vendor copy and import the canonical util so we don't diverge. PR #4515 will remove the duplicate and add unit tests for composed vs decomposed input.
Ivy Zhao: after we normalize and align slugify, run `yarn docs:linkcheck` locally then push. once CI is green, we can drop the temporary redirects after a week of monitoring.
docs-bot: CI: docs/build-staging succeeded for PR #4512 and PR #4515  all checks passed :white_check_mark:
Tara Singh: thanks all. follow-ups: Ben to land exporter/slugify dedupe, Ivy to land lint rule, Luna to add redirect entries and schedule removal in a follow-up PR, Tara to sweep remaining international guides. ping here if any customer 404s show up.
Luna Park: added redirects:
- from: "/guides/international#installing-with-locale"
  to: "/guides/international#installing-with-locale"
(note: the manifest stores the canonical fragment; this mapping keeps old encoded/decomposed hits alive.)
Ben Walker: merging slugify change in 5m once CI completes.
Ivy Zhao: linter PR includes tests for both NFC and NFD variants. will monitor for any flaky test failures.
Tara Singh: closing thread after post-deploy sweep. thanks everyone!
